summary: Continues the current line. A small network trained on one repository.
limitations: Often suggests wrong, repetitive or invalid code. It is here to evaluate, not to rely on: read what it suggests before you keep it.

provenance.corpus: WpfStudio's own C# source. No Microsoft model weights or predictions.

evaluation: 120 held-out statement suffixes, lexical replay: 10 matched ignoring literals and whitespace, 6 matched exactly. Usefulness in real editing was not measured.
